notes: «- وقال نصر : عن ابن أبي ذئب، والأوزاعي،» is Nasr's own version of the same saying: it names a different transmitter at the Awza'i level, so it is a variant group and never a route
«- وهذا لفظه -» and «- رضى الله عنها -» are editor's glosses and are left out; the Prophet is the end of the chain
